signals.normalized_summary: Ship imperial unit support for Aurora Manufacturing's US plant employees by 2026-10-15 to satisfy the explicit renewal condition on their $5,000 contract (also O2-KR5, ADR-005).

Establish a product policy that data rectification and own-data export are unconditionally free (compliance obligations under GDPR and O2), while cohort reporting for employers is separately billable on the corporate plan.
Add per-user imperial/metric unit preference — all 6 competitors support it, the US is ~63% of category revenue, and the analyst estimates it as a two-day fix that is currently a conversion blocker.
MacroMint (Aug 2026) moved unit preference to an explicit per-user setting across all surfaces, corroborating the unit-system gap is a fast-win with 2-week parity estimate.
Add a unitSystem preference field to HealthProfile and apply SI-canonical storage with display-layer conversion (per ADR-005) to meet Aurora Manufacturing's Q4 renewal condition and O2-KR5.

Implement weekly and monthly progress reports — all 6 competitors ship periodic reports and Kiro Fit cannot render any history beyond the current week, which the analyst flags as a shared dependency for retention, coaching, and period comparison.
FitLedger (Jul 2026) shipped weekly and monthly progress reports with generated narrative, corroborating that periodic reports are table-stakes and parity is 6 weeks of engineering effort.

Implement a working paid subscription flow — every competitor monetises successfully, 9,877 users have tapped Upgrade into a placeholder toast, and the product currently generates zero revenue despite demonstrated purchase intent.
Implement a server-side range query and aggregation resolver for the health table to enable periodic progress reports (O1-KR2, O6-KR1) and eliminate N+1 fan-out blocking every analytics feature.
Build the webhook endpoint and entitlement store for Stride Payments before 2026-09-30 or lose the Q3 integration slot and delay billing by at least 6 weeks, blocking O3-KR1.
Add a per-user unit system preference (imperial/metric) stored in profile and applied to all display and entry surfaces.
Narrow API-key read scope to exclude dob and location fields in the GraphQL schema and API construct to close the open high pen-test finding (F-01/F-02) and meet O2-KR4.
Add generated exercise plan capability — 5 of 6 competitors ship it and it is the headline paid feature for two, making Kiro Fit a non-entry in the category's core retention mechanic.

PulseCoach (Jul 2026) shipped AI-generated weekly-adapting training plans as its headline paid feature, and VitalWorks added programme-level plan seeding in Aug 2026 — corroborating the exercise-plan gap as the single highest-urgency competitive exposure.

Analyst confirms the absence of any plan concept makes Kiro Fit a category non-entry on prescription — the variable with r≈0.68 correlation to W4 retention — requiring plan data-model work before any surface feature can ship.

Configure enterprise SSO (SAML/OIDC) via Cognito federation — VitalWorks ships it on all plans, it is a procurement gate for corporate wellness buyers, and Cognito already supports it but is unconfigured.

VitalWorks (Jun 2026) shipped SOC 2 Type II, SAML SSO, and SCIM for all plans, removing the enterprise security objection at the low end — directly threatening Kiro Fit's enterprise pipeline with 8-week parity estimate.

Implement history range queries beyond 7 days — all competitors provide it, the premium gate exists but is unimplemented, and the analyst identifies it as the shared dependency unblocking periodic reports, period comparison, and the plan feedback loop.
Build the analytics/insights screen — it is universal across all competitors, advertised as a premium feature, and has neither a route nor a page, creating a trust and retention gap.
Add ARIA roles and accessible semantics to WeeklySummary and StatGrid components to unblock VPAT publication and satisfy O4-KR3 for corporate-wellness procurement.
Extend the GraphQL schema to add a planned-session type and planned-vs-completed concept, unblocking plan generation (O1-KR1, O1-KR4) and the AI coaching charter (O6-KR1).

Every pricing and packaging decision is theoretical until the Stride Payments integration (PC-007 slot expires 2026-09-30) delivers a checkout and entitlement store; this is the blocking constraint on O3.
Add ARIA roles and accessible labels to the weekly progress ring and stats grid so VoiceOver and screen readers can convey goal progress to blind users.

Deliver in-product monthly cohort participation reports by 2026-11-01 as a named deliverable in Helios Health's expansion agreement, unblocking the 4,200-seat upgrade worth $14,400 ARR (O4-KR2, O4-KR4).
Ship SAML/OIDC SSO by 2026-10-15 to unlock the 4,200-seat Helios expansion; corporate cohorts retain 2-3x better than consumer so this segment has the highest LTV leverage (O4-KR1, O4-KR4).
Configure SAML 2.0 / OIDC federation on the existing Cognito user pool with tenant-aware sign-in and SCIM-lite deprovisioning for enterprise pilots.
Implement anonymised cohort participation export (CSV) — active users, days logged, adherence per department — as a gated enterprise/admin feature.

Begin SOC 2 Type II observation immediately — each month of delay pushes enterprise ARR pipeline out by a month, VitalWorks is already certified on all plans, and the 6-9 month observation period means any delay is linear.

Prioritise enterprise entry gates (SSO, cohort reporting, accessibility conformance, security attestation) — corporate wellness cohorts retain 2-3x better than consumer, making enterprise the primary path to durable ARR given category-wide consumer churn in the mid-teens.
Implement billing provider integration (Stride Payments PC-007 slot expires 2026-09-30) and tier-claim write-back to unlock free-to-paid conversion, directly enabling O3-KR1.

Remove dob and location from the API-key-authorized Query.profile selection set (split PublicProfile type) and drop @aws_api_key from Query.profile to close active PII enumeration via the publicly distributed API key.

Remove or clearly gate-label all five unimplemented premium feature flags in access.ts and SubscriptionPage.vue to eliminate deceptive-marketing exposure and block refund/trust damage risk, supporting O3-KR2.
Reframe the premium boundary to exclude plan generation and weight trends — competitors now offer these for free — or risk being perceived as charging for the category floor.

~18,300 help-centre searches for imperial units (pounds, lbs, feet, miles, stone) return zero results because no imperial unit support exists, making this the single largest unmet-demand cluster in the help centre and the cheapest of the three missing capabilities to ship.
Build weekly and monthly progress reports showing totals, period-over-period trends, and a shareable/exportable summary.

Adopt managed foundation model for plan generation and report narration — published unit economics are $0.01–0.05 per MAU (NutriPilot: $0.018), well inside subscription margin, and hand-built rule engines are now the more expensive and maintenance-heavier alternative.

NutriPilot (Aug 2026) published $0.018/MAU for plan generation on a managed model with a static-plan fallback — corroborating that GenAI-powered plans are economically viable and operationally safe at consumer scale.

Per-token pricing for small/mid foundation models fell again as of Sep 2026 with batch/cached-prompt discounts standard — the economic case for a hand-built rule-engine approach is now weaker than managed-model generation.

Prioritise exercise plan generation and periodic progress reports to move W4 retention from 19% to the 28% target (O1-KR3), as these are the two capabilities users name by name and competitors already ship for free.
Shipping a working subscription checkout and entitlement write-back is the singular unlock for free-to-paid conversion, which is structurally 0% despite 9,877 tapped upgrade intents (O3-KR1, O3-KR3).

Resolve three open pricing decisions this quarter — price point vs $12.99/mo category, trial length given 190s time-to-log, and per-seat vs per-participant corporate pricing — before the billing instrument ships.
Deliver de-identified cohort export and GDPR data-subject access by 2027-01-31 to retain Aurora Manufacturing's 610-seat renewal ($17,900 ARR), noting wearable integration is a non-goal until FY27.
Ship the ready-to-ship WCAG AA contrast token fix for dark mode to remove the procurement blocker for corporate wellness accounts and advance O4-KR3.

An HR professional in r/humanresources states SSO and a VPAT are non-negotiable procurement requirements, providing direct buyer-voice confirmation that these gaps will block enterprise deals regardless of product quality.
A Wellness Builders pilot of 240 employees showed Kiro Fit outperforming the incumbent on preference, but the program manager confirms it will be rejected at procurement without SSO.

Across 14 competitor job postings, all investment is in data pipelines, integrations, and enterprise gates — nobody is hiring for interface craft — confirming Kiro Fit's design differentiation is unchallenged but its functional gaps are being actively closed by rivals.
Implement AI-generated training plan that uses the user's profile, goal, and logged history to produce a multi-week programme with rest days and regeneration.
Implement Apple Health (iOS) and Health Connect (Android) two-way sync to auto-import workouts and export weight/activity data.

Fix axe serious accessibility violations and publish a VPAT — the EU Accessibility Act is already in enforcement, Helios procurement requires a VPAT by 2026-12-01, and LeanLoop published conformance in July 2026 and is using it in competitive bids.
LeanLoop (Jul 2026) published full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance with an ACR and is actively using it in procurement, directly threatening Helios and other enterprise prospects.
EU European Accessibility Act enforcement began 2025-06-28 and is a current procurement blocker at Helios — axe serious violations on primary screens must be remediated now.

Implement data export (CSV/JSON) — it is advertised as a premium feature but unimplemented, creating both a compliance obligation (GDPR right of access) and a deceptive advertising risk as long as it remains unpurchasable.

VitalWorks (Jun 2026) shipped de-identified cohort CSV export for benefits teams, creating an enterprise-tier export differentiator that Kiro Fit lacks entirely and that blocks the Aurora account renewal.

Address GDPR/state-privacy rights gaps (access export, erasure, rectification) — all three are absent, the 30-day erasure SLA cannot be met reliably, and the access/erasure work shares a schema surface with the top consumer request to edit logged sessions.
Add update and delete mutations to the GraphQL schema for health items to satisfy GDPR rectification/erasure obligations and close the top consumer complaint, directly enabling O2-KR1 and O2-KR3.
Instrument AppSync 5xx, throttling, and Lambda-error alarms and define initial SLOs to reduce MTTD from 4.6 days to under 30 minutes per O5-KR1/KR2 and unblock the SOC 2 observation window (PC-009).
Fix the guest-to-account migration so all locally stored entries are reliably transferred on sign-up, without silent data loss.

A public HN post (88 pts) disclosed that Kiro Fit ships its AppSync API key in config.json and exposes date-of-birth via enumerable profile queries — the same finding as PEN-2026-03 F-02, now public and requiring urgent remediation.

Two active Kiro Fit corporate pilots in a 4.2k-member practitioner community confirm employee preference over incumbents but identify the sign-up data-loss bug as the reason the praised guest-onboarding design pattern is not being adopted by competitors.
Fix guest sync data loss: per-entry failures silently swallow errors then unconditionally clear localStorage, permanently destroying activity data for ~1,712+ users per cohort.
Rewrite guest-sync composable to use a fault-tolerant mutation queue with idempotency keys (per ADR-007), reducing guest data-loss rate from 39% to below 0.5% per O2-KR2.

Build the managed model invocation path with token budget, per-user cost ceiling alarm, and deterministic fallback in the existing Lambda/resolver stack (per ADR-010) before shipping any AI capability under O6.
Replace per-date scalar queries with a range-parameterized resolver to eliminate 7x read-cost and throttling exposure, unblocking all analytics and history features per O3-KR2 and O1-KR2.

Treat ADR-010's AI charter as the authoritative decision framework: ship plan generation (~6 days) and report narration through the managed-model path only after the five unmet preconditions in TD-2026-34 are resolved.

Viral a11y post (874 likes, 211 reposts) calls out Kiro Fit's progress ring as inaccessible to VoiceOver users, citing missing aria-valuenow on the primary UI metric and damaging reputation in the accessibility community.

Instrument analytics events on key product surfaces (exercise dashboard, plan, report) to make plan-adherence measurable (O1-KR4) and enable the funnel analysis required to validate O3's conversion hypothesis.
Deliver SAML/OIDC SSO, de-identified cohort export, and WCAG 2.2 AA compliance by 2026-10-15 to secure Helios Health's 4,200-seat expansion (O4-KR1, O4-KR4) worth $17,880 ARR at risk.

Add HealthKit and Health Connect wearable sync — it is a universal category expectation, PulseCoach (May 2026) made it a two-way GA feature positioning itself as the hub, and Capacitor 8 is already configured but no native builds exist.
PulseCoach (May 2026) shipped two-way HealthKit/Health Connect sync GA, positioning itself as the hub — creating a 12-week parity gap for Kiro Fit that grows with each passing sprint.

Remove or gate the six unimplemented Premium claims from SubscriptionPage.vue immediately — advertising undeliverable features creates deceptive-practice exposure and measurable trust damage (NPS-4526, ZD-11061) while the product has no billing mechanism.
Implement admin audit logging and deploy alerting to start the SOC 2 Type II 6-month observation window (PC-009, $28,000 contract); blocked on the same observability gap addressed by O5.

The upgrade funnel has a hard zero at checkout_started for 21+ consecutive weeks because handleUpgrade() shows a placeholder toast instead of a billing flow, meaning ~9,877 intent signals produced zero revenue.

Users whose week-1 sessions were all verbatim repeats retain at only ~11% by W4 versus ~21% for general loggers and ~35% for history viewers, making the repeat-session pattern a measurable churn predictor requiring a plan or variety feature to break.

EXP-2026-047 showed a display-only imperial toggle lifted profile completion 22.7% and cut implausible-weight warnings 81% (18.4%→3.5%), the largest quarterly effect for the smallest change — but full entry conversion is still needed.
Implement a self-serve GDPR/DSAR path — data export and account deletion — to meet enterprise DPA obligations within the required 30-day SLA.
Platform policy now permits web-first billing in most jurisdictions, making a web-based subscription checkout viable without a native app launch — unblocking revenue sooner than previously assumed.
PulseCoach (Aug 2026) shipped weight trend with moving average and forecast band as a free feature — co-opting the single most-requested Kiro Fit premium analytic and increasing urgency to build it.

Three hard dates gate near-term ARR: Helios security re-review by 2026-10-15 (4,200-seat expansion), Helios VPAT by 2026-12-01 (procurement stop), and Aurora renewal by 2027-01-31 ($17.9k ARR) — each requiring specific product work that is currently unstarted.

Fix the guest-to-account sync path that loses data — the guest mode is a genuine differentiator (rare in the category) but is actively undermined by data loss on sign-up, converting an advantage into churn at the funnel's critical step.
A high-engagement r/fitness post (284 engagements) frames Kiro Fit as beautiful but passive, citing the absence of plan generation and a monthly progress view as the core product gap.

Three consecutive r/loseit tracker comparison threads in 2026 cite the same Kiro Fit blockers (no training suggestion, no month view), and the August thread adds 'abandoned-looking' as a new signal that perceived development velocity is now itself a churn risk.
Integrate a billing provider and implement the premium upgrade purchase flow — the upgrade CTA currently shows a placeholder toast.
Build the analytics / insights screen that premium feature gates advertise, or remove the false advertising until it ships.

Replace the per-day exerciseEntries query fan-out with a single date-range query (sk between EXERCISE#<start> and EXERCISE#<end>) to eliminate the N+1 that caused the SEV1 throttling incident affecting 8,144 users.

CLDR 46 (effective 2026-10-01) changes measurement-system defaults for several locales, meaning locale-derived unit guessing will produce wrong results — an explicit per-user unit preference avoids this dependency entirely.
Upgrade eslint, vite, cypress, and Node to current non-EOL versions per ADR-008 to resolve unpatched CVEs and satisfy the SOC 2 dependency-currency observation requirement (PC-009).

71.2% of exercise logging sessions are verbatim repeats of the previous session across 21 weeks with up to 9 consecutive identical sessions, entirely because there is no plan or suggestion feature to diversify activity.

~15,700 help-centre searches for generated workout plans, training programs, and progressive overload guidance return zero results because no plan generation feature exists, and avg_retries of 2.8-3.4 show users persist before abandoning.

Enforce ADR-006's single-command deployability constraint on every new capability, including AI features, meaning all model invocations must route through existing Lambda/resolvers rather than containerised agents.

Viewing exercise history in week 1 predicts W4 retention at 35% versus 21% for logging alone, making history access a top retention lever — yet 31% of history views are abandoned before render due to latency.
PulseCoach has 3 open ML roles for LLM-based plan generation with prompt evaluation and cost-per-inference ownership, treating AI plan generation as a production product line rather than a prototype.

Implement billing integration end-to-end: replace the placeholder toast in handleUpgrade() with a real payment provider flow and add a Cognito pre-token-generation trigger to write the tier claim so premium access gates actually function.

Every upgrade_tapped event resolves to a placeholder toast reading "Premium subscriptions will be available soon" with no checkout flow, confirmed across the event sample and consistent with the funnel hard-zero at checkout_started.

Adopt the ADR-001 weekly schema batch-review process explicitly in the team's definition of done to prevent one schema change from serially blocking plan generation, range queries, units, erasure, and report types.

6,188 profile_unit_confusion events across 2,417 users in en-US/en-GB locales store implausible metric values (weightKg=154, heightCm=5.9) because the profile form has no imperial input option, corrupting body-metric data.
FitLedger is building periodic reporting with AI-generated narrative summaries as a dedicated product surface, directly competing with the progress_reports_periodic gap in Kiro Fit.

HN commenter (96 engagement) observes that every fitness tracker that survived recent consolidation did so by generating plans rather than storing logs, and argues the inference cost is now negligible.
Switching to a DynamoDB range query pattern cuts read cost ~7x versus the current per-day fan-out — making history queries both cheaper and faster while unblocking all history-dependent features.

AppSync default throttle limits are the binding constraint on history queries — the current N+1 per-day fan-out multiplies both cost and throttle exposure, requiring a range-query resolver before history features can scale.

39.8% of history sessions attempt a date-range change every week but 100% fail because Query.exerciseEntries requires a single AWSDate parameter, making the history view effectively a single-week-only view permanently.

EXP-2026-041 confirmed demand for adaptive exercise plans: a hardcoded starter week lifted W2 return 11.4% and cut verbatim repeats from 71% to 58%, but 34% abandoned the static plan by week 3, proving the need for an adaptive generation system rather than a static card.
Build a weight trend chart on the profile page, storing a time-series of weight entries and displaying a moving-average line over selectable periods.

Establish the AI delivery charter (cost/benefit doc, fallback path, CI eval suite per ADR-010) as the pre-condition for shipping plan generation and report narration under O6, with inference cost ceiling of $0.04/MAU.
VitalWorks is investing in privacy-safe cohort analytics and scheduled CSV delivery, treating employer-facing reporting as a renewal lever that Kiro Fit cannot currently match.

Analysis of the 118-comment HN thread shows product incompleteness as the #2 theme and a 62% bounce from /tabs/exercise, confirming the exercise-tab feature gap is the primary acquisition conversion failure.
Fix the profile photo upload endpoint to accept HEIC images from iPhones by adding HEIC to the allowed content-type list.

Implement a delete mutation and account-deletion endpoint to fulfil GDPR/DPA erasure obligations within 30 days; the current process of ad-hoc engineer DynamoDB deletes is an open SEV2 compliance incident.
Enable CloudTrail data events on the kirofit-media S3 bucket to satisfy the audit-log requirement from enterprise customer Helios Health Systems (ZD-11122).

MacroMint (Jul 2026) raised price to $12.99/mo while removing its free-tier logging cap, signalling the category can sustain higher pricing while free must be genuinely capable — Kiro Fit has no paid tier at all.

~15,000 help-centre searches for weekly/monthly progress reports and date-range history return zero results because no periodic reporting or export exists, with 54-63% abandonment after multiple retries confirming strong unmet demand.

Subscription page DAU share grew from 2.57% to 3.20% April–August while exercise_log share declined 40.86% to 32.13%, indicating purchase intent is rising as core engagement weakens — revenue is being lost every day checkout does not exist.
Add HEIC/HEIF support to the photo upload presigned-URL allowlist (or transcode client-side) so iOS users can upload photos taken with the default camera format without a silent error.
Developer community members praise Kiro Fit's guest onboarding as best-in-class but report that guest data is lost at sign-up, directly undermining the conversion the onboarding is designed to drive.
A paid trial user (390 likes) publicly criticises Kiro Fit for advertising premium features that are universally 'coming soon', creating a billing trust issue that will suppress paid conversions.
Implement idempotent multi-device sync so signing in on a second device does not produce duplicate log entries.

History views issue 7 sequential fan-out queries with render times up to 9.6s, causing 31% of sessions to be abandoned before render, while EXP-2026-034 (running) shows a single range query cuts p95 from 8,940ms to 1,180ms and abandonment from 31% to 6.2%.

EXP-2026-034 (running) demonstrates the range-query refactor cuts history p95 render from 8,940ms to 1,180ms and abandonment from 31.1% to 6.2%, but is blocked on a schema review that also covers unit-preference and plan/report types, making ADR-001 the critical-path blocker for three features.

VitalWorks is actively hiring 2 senior SSO/SCIM engineers, signalling that enterprise SAML/OIDC and SCIM provisioning is a funded competitor priority Kiro Fit must match to remain viable in corporate wellness procurement.
Remove or fix the 7-day history cap so users can browse past exercises by month and year.

A wellness coach reports Kiro Fit is unusable in client sessions because there is neither a session-reviewable report nor a between-session programme to assign, blocking the B2B practitioner persona entirely.
Add role=progressbar, aria-valuenow/valuemin/valuemax, and a text alternative to WeeklySummary and StatGrid so screen reader users receive meaningful progress information instead of an empty group.

Only ~17% of guest sessions convert to signup despite 49-51% seeing the prompt, a persistent 67% drop at the prompt-to-start step across 21 weeks, confirmed to be improvable 54.5% by deferring the prompt to post-entry composition (EXP-2026-007, ship-blocked).

Implement or remove the five premium feature gates (analytics, data-export, custom-activities, community, exercise-history-full) that are advertised on the subscription page but have no code path, causing trust damage with trialists.
Escape or sanitize HTML in the bio field before rendering in the shared profile view to close the stored XSS vector confirmed by bug bounty BB-2026-027.

Record the ADR-004 revisit gate (two corporate accounts requesting wearables OR reminder-experiment lift sustaining 60 days) so wearable-integration requests from Aurora and Helios can be evaluated against an explicit threshold rather than deferred indefinitely.

Corporate program members retain at ~44% W4 and ~36% W8, the highest of any cohort segment, indicating that structured external accountability drives sustained engagement and justifying prioritising the corporate/B2B program surface.

EXP-2026-007 proved that deferring the guest sign-up prompt to post-entry composition lifts signup conversion 54.5% (p<0.0001) but is ship-blocked because it requires a local draft/outbox that does not exist, which is the same dependency as offline mode and the sync-loss fix.
Add a streak counter (consecutive logging days) and weekly achievement badges to reinforce daily logging habits.

EXP-2026-019 confirmed premium page copy advertising unbuilt features causes 4.8 complaint tickets per 1k views and NPS 4.1; shipping 'coming soon' labelling reduced complaints 75% and raised NPS to 5.6 — shipped, confirming trust damage from un-built premium features.

Deliver participation summary export by 2026-09-30 to retain Northwind Logistics' second wellness-program cycle; note that community challenges are a Q3 non-goal (NG3), so only the export path is in scope.
LeanLoop is productising WCAG 2.2 conformance with a dedicated contractor specifically to use an ACR as a procurement differentiator against competitors including Kiro Fit.
Define and begin executing an AI/GenAI product charter — users expect the app to generate plans and explain progress in natural language, not just record data.
Add idempotency key to logExercise mutation so that replaying a guest-cache on a second device does not create unremovable duplicate exercise entries.
FitLedger (Jun 2026) shipped streaks, badges, and smart reminder timing — Kiro Fit has no engagement loop at all, contributing to a 71% verbatim session repeat rate and below-median retention.

r/androiddev post (312 upvotes) states definitively that Android fitness apps require Health Connect integration, meaning Kiro Fit's web-only architecture explicitly excludes the Android fitness market.
Implement a date-range query for exerciseEntries and wire the history range picker so users can view more than the current week without a silent no-op or 30 individual round trips.
Build an admin-accessible audit log of participation data access events to satisfy enterprise compliance requirements ahead of Q1 expansion.
axe-core has rising momentum (71 stars/30d) with mature WCAG 2.2 rules and trivial Cypress integration, making it the cheapest credible route to automated accessibility CI gates for Kiro Fit.

Kiro Fit's HN front-page moment (242 pts, 11.4k sessions) converted architecture appreciation but 62% of visitors bounced from /tabs/calories, identifying the calorie-tracking surface as the critical acquisition drop-off.
Add an offline write-queue so log entries created without network are stored locally and synced automatically on reconnection.

Report export is invoked by users each week but returns a hard zero at every step because no report or export code path exists, while the readout confirms users specifically want weekly and monthly summaries.

Only ~61% of guest sign-ups successfully sync their pre-signup exercise data because per-entry sync failures are silently swallowed and the local cache is cleared, causing ~39% of converting guests to lose their workout history.
An X outage complaint was the first internal signal of INC-2026-041, with 29-minute detection lag, indicating the observability gap means users detect incidents before Kiro Fit's own monitoring does.
Add a client-side error-mapping layer (mirroring lib/auth/utils/errorMessages.ts) to translate raw Apollo/GraphQL error strings into user-friendly messages before they are displayed.

Any native iOS/Android launch requires App Store and Play privacy manifests for all bundled SDKs (Cognito, Apollo, analytics) — plan 2-3 weeks of declaration work as part of the native build milestone.
NutriPilot is hiring 3 engineers for offline write queues with idempotency, corroborating FitLedger's offline investment and establishing offline-first as a category-wide expectation.
Implement workout reminder push notifications (web push for now) so users can receive configurable nudges on planned training days.
Fix dark mode token contrast to meet WCAG AA (≥4.5:1) on key stat figures — the current deep-purple-on-black palette is illegible outdoors.
Implement an offline-capable Apollo cache and mutation queue so that users on flaky or offline connections retain form state and can log exercises that sync on reconnect.
Add CloudWatch alarms and dashboards on AppSync 5xx and Lambda error rates so incidents are detected by telemetry rather than Twitter or support tickets (current MTTD: up to 4.6 days).

EXP-2026-027 showed raising dark-mode contrast to WCAG AA (4.7:1 from 2.6:1) lifted dashboard task success 16.8% and reduced contrast-related support tickets 86% with no meaningful aesthetic cost — experiment decided to ship but not yet deployed.

Discover article DAU share collapsed from 7.59% to 0.50% between April and August because no new content has been published since 2026-07-01, and the Discover list (still the second most-visited surface) is now driving users to a stale dead-end.

Every guest_sync_partial_failure event has local_cache_cleared:true, confirming that partial sync failures silently destroy unsynced guest data; this is the blocker preventing EXP-2026-007's 54.5% conversion lift from shipping.

logExercise mutation error rate increased 3.4x after release r-1.0.14 on 2026-06-18 (INC-2026-029) and a separate 6x query error spike on 2026-07-27 (INC-2026-041) went undetected because no alerting existed, indicating systematic reliability and observability gaps.
A high-engagement r/loseit post (229 upvotes) states that streak + dinner-time reminder is the minimum retention mechanism, and apps missing both lose users by week 3.
A fitness-tech X post reports uninstalling Kiro Fit within a week specifically because metric-only weight entry is a usability blocker for the US audience the product targets.
Publish native iOS and Android apps to the App Store / Play Store using the existing Capacitor 8 setup so users get home-screen widgets and reliable push.
Google Fit REST APIs retired 2026-06-30 in favour of Health Connect — any Android wearable integration must now target Health Connect, which is also the standard enterprise Android fleet expects.
HealthKit requires a native container — web-only distribution structurally blocks the top wearable ask, making a native Capacitor build a prerequisite for any HealthKit integration.
PulseCoach is hiring 4 mobile engineers focused on HealthKit/Health Connect two-way sync, directly targeting the wearable aggregation gap that Kiro Fit has not yet addressed.
The Bedrock prompt-eval-harness has the highest star velocity in the dataset (612/30d) and fills the missing ADR-010 eval gap, making it the fastest path to making plan generation testable in CI.
Langfuse (741 stars/30d, rising) provides per-user inference cost and latency tracking that directly serves the O6-KR2 ceiling KR at lower cost than building attribution in-house.

EXP-2026-031 (running, 17-day interim) shows web push reminders at the user's historical logging time reactivate lapsing users at 141% lift (14.7% vs 6.1%), but iOS PWA install requirement limits opt-in to 34% vs 71% on Android, reinforcing the native app gap.

EXP-2026-044 showed a weekly recap screen lifts return visits 9.1% confirming user demand, but was stopped because the 7-query fan-out hit 11.2s p95 and 28% abandonment — the experiment should be re-run once EXP-2026-034's range query is shipped.

FitLedger (Apr 2026) shipped offline-first logging with 30-day queue — Kiro Fit has a network-only fetch policy and no outbox, making it unusable in low-connectivity scenarios where competitors work fine.

Migrate AppSync resolvers to the current JS runtime before writing new range-query resolvers — runtime 1.0.0 is frozen and reaches EOL 2027-03-31, so authoring range queries on it would force a second migration.
Add a per-user unit-system preference to HealthProfile and convert display/entry between imperial and metric so that en-US/en-GB users stop persisting implausible weight/height values.
Add server-side input validation to all resolvers (starting with logExercise) to enforce the same bounds as the client zod schema, preventing direct API abuse from corrupting user data.
Fix dark mode CSS token contrast ratios (currently 2.6:1) to meet WCAG AA (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large), starting with the weekly minutes figure on the dashboard.

Instrument dead-end interactions (placeholder toasts, no-op controls, unimplemented feature surfaces) with analytics events so demand can be measured directly rather than reconstructed from help-centre search logs.
Add a content-length condition to the presigned S3 upload URL so that arbitrary-size object writes are rejected at the storage layer, not just at the client.
Add WAF or per-token rate limiting in front of AppSync to enforce a write budget per authenticated token, closing the confirmed ability to issue 12,000 logExercise mutations per minute.
Reduce presigned upload URL expiry from 3600s to a minimum (e.g. 300s) and invalidate outstanding URLs on key rotation to close the re-upload window from BB-2026-023.
Strengthen the Cognito user pool password policy to require ≥12 characters and enable compromised-credentials detection to reduce account takeover risk.
